chunks.standardTitle: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)
chunks.clauseTitle: Statutory Scheme Regulation & Mandate
chunks.source: Level 1: BIS Act 2016 & Conformity Regulations
chunks.text: BIS Conformity Assessment Scheme: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS). Statutory Authority: BIS Act 2016 Section 13 & Conformity Assessment Regulations 2018 Regulation 3(1)(b). Identifier Format: CM/L-XXXXXXX (Standard ISI Mark with designated country identification). Summary:  FMCS is officially described as the scheme through which BIS grants licences to foreign manufacturers under the BIS Act and Conformity Assessment Regulations.  Nomination of an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) is legally mandatory. The AIR must be a resident of India, declare legal responsibility, and represent the foreign manufacturer in compliance and legal matters.
keywords: cm/l-xxxxxxx (standard isi mark with designated country identification)

chunks.standardTitle: Scheme-IV (Hallmarking of Gold and Silver Jewellery)

chunks.source: Level 1: BIS Act 2016 & Conformity Regulations
chunks.text: BIS Conformity Assessment Scheme: Scheme-IV (Hallmarking of Gold and Silver Jewellery). Statutory Authority: BIS (Hallmarking) Regulations 2018 & Mandatory Hallmarking Order S.O. 15.01.2020. Identifier Format: 6-Character Alphanumeric HUID (e.g. AB1234). Summary:   If hallmarked jewellery tested at an Assaying & Hallmarking Centre is found substandard in purity, the jeweller shall compensate the consumer with 3 times (3X) the difference in value of the shortage in purity, along with full refund of testing fees.
keywords: scheme-iv (hallmarking of gold and silver jewellery)
